documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Submission Of Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30Th September, 2026

analysis.summary: JG Chemicals reported its best-ever quarterly performance in Q2 FY27, driven by healthy demand across end-user industries, a favorable product mix, and focused execution. Revenue, EBITDA, and PAT scaled new quarterly highs, with management highlighting strong volume growth and capacity utilization exceeding 80%. The company is progressing with its expansion plans at Dahej and Naidupeta, which are expected to support anticipated demand through FY28 and FY29. Management remains confident about sustaining strong demand and improving EBITDA margins toward the 14% to 15% range over the next three years. J.G.

guidance.claim: The company expects EBITDA margins to reach approximately 14% to 15% with a higher share of value-added products.
guidance.quote: So, going forward, our target would be to get to an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with the higher share of value-added products that we are foraying into now.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that Q3 demand across all customer end-user applications remains strong.
demand_outlook.quote: Even currently in Q3, we are witnessing strong demand across all our customer end-user applications, and we are confident of surpassing the numbers achieved till now.

demand_outlook.claim: Automotive industry volumes grew robustly in Q2 FY27 supported by festive demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The automotive industry maintained very strong momentum in Q2 FY27, supported also by the festive demand.

demand_outlook.claim: The automotive industry maintained strong momentum in Q2 FY27, supported by festive demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The automotive industry maintained strong momentum in Q2 FY27, supported by festive demand.

demand_outlook.claim: According to ATMA/SIAM estimates, passenger vehicle volumes grew 30.7% YoY, two-wheelers 15.2%, commercial vehicles 28.7% and three-wheelers 23.6%.
demand_outlook.quote: According to ATMA/SIAM estimates, passenger vehicle volumes grew 30.7% YoY, two-wheelers 15.2%, commercial vehicles 28.7% and three-wheelers 23.6%.

demand_outlook.claim: Despite West Asia disruptions, Indian tyre majors are progressing with approximately 25,000 crore of announced capex to meet growing OEM and replacement demand and expand exports, which account for around 25% of Indian tyre production.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite West Asia disruptions, Indian tyre majors are progressing with approximately ₹25,000 crore of announced capex to meet growing OEM and replacement demand and expand exports, which account for around 25% of Indian tyre production.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through the previous quarter and Q4 ending FY26, continuing into the current quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as demand is concerned, our customers, the tire and the rubber, remain the largest pillar of our business, and demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through the previous quarter and Q4 ending FY26, and this has continued into the current quarter also.

demand_outlook.claim: ATMA reported year-on-year volume growth across major vehicle categories in Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: As per ATMA, the Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories: passenger vehicles growing up to 26.6%, two-wheelers 16.5%, commercial vehicles 16.48%, and three-wheelers more than 11% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management notes encouraging traction in non-rubber segments such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agriculture.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as the non-rubber applications are concerned, outside the rubber and tire, we continue to see encouraging traction in the non-rubber segment such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agri.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield project is nearing completion with trial runs scheduled for next month.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1, comprising approximately 15,000 metric tons per annum of zinc oxide capacity within the planned 40,000-plus metric tons facility, is nearing completion now with trial runs scheduled for next month.

capex_expansion.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion is on track for commissioning in January.
capex_expansion.quote: So within January, we will commission that.

capex_expansion.claim: BDJ Oxides Private Limited acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta during 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Further strengthening our long-term expansion plan, JG, through its material subsidiary, BDJ Oxides Private Limited, acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta in Tirupati District, Andhra during 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield project, comprising approximately 15,000 MTPA of zinc oxide capacity within the planned 40,000+ MTPA facility, is nearing completion, with trial runs scheduled for next month.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 of the Dahej greenfield project, comprising approximately 15,000 MTPA of zinc oxide capacity within the planned 40,000+ MTPA facility, is nearing completion, with trial runs scheduled for next month.

capex_expansion.claim: Together, these additions will increase total zinc oxide capacity to 79,904 MTPA, providing capacity to support anticipated demand through FY28 and FY29.
capex_expansion.quote: Together, these additions will increase total zinc oxide capacity to 79,904 MTPA, providing capacity to support anticipated demand through FY28 and FY29.

capex_expansion.claim: The material subsidiary BDJ Oxides Pvt Ltd has acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta, Tirupati district, Andhra Pradesh, in 2026, to support future capacity expansion and long-term growth.
capex_expansion.quote: Our material subsidiary i.e. BDJ Oxides Pvt Ltd has acquired approximately 16.74 acres of freehold land at Naidupeta, Tirupati district, Andhra Pradesh, in 2026, to support future capacity expansion and long-term growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahej greenfield chemical facility involves an investment of about INR 100 crores with an estimated revenue potential of INR 900 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: With an investment of about INR100 crores, the estimated revenue potential will be INR900 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The brownfield expansion at the Naidupeta facility is expected to be commissioned in Q3 of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: The brownfield expansion at our Naidupeta facility is also progressing well in parallel, and we expect to commission that also in the Q3 of the current financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: Civil work at the Dahej facility is in advanced stages and equipment installation is underway.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to the Dahej greenfield capacity expansion in Gujarat, the company is progressing well with its 40,000 plus MTA zinc greenfield chemical facility in Dahej. The civil work is in advanced stages and equipment installation is already underway.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 10.71%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR38.65 crores, up 77% year-on-year and 7% sequentially with an EBITDA margin of 10.71%.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin for H1 FY27 was 11.07%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA was at INR74.9 crores, up 66% year-on-year with an EBITDA margin of 11.07%.

margins_costs.claim: JGC recorded an EBITDA margin of 10.71% in Q2 FY27, improving 79 bps YoY from 9.92%, despite higher energy prices and freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: JGC recorded an EBITDA margin of 10.71% in Q2 FY27, improving 79 bps YoY from 9.92%, despite higher energy prices and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 7.74 %, improving 92 bps YoY from 6.82%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin for Q2 FY27 stood at 7.74 %, improving 92 bps YoY from 6.82%.

margins_costs.claim: The Company's pricing model enables pass-through of zinc price movements, helping mitigate raw material price risk.
margins_costs.quote: The Company’s pricing model enables pass-through of zinc price movements, helping mitigate raw material price risk.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for Q1 FY27 was INR 26.1 crores with a margin of 8.27%.
margins_costs.quote: The PAT for the quarter was INR26.1 crores with a PAT margin of 8.27% as compared to 7.52% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Management states the company is neutral to zinc price volatility.
margins_costs.quote: We are neutral to zinc prices, if you ask me honestly. So, whether zinc is at 3,000 or 3,500 or 3,600, it really doesn't matter to us.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity of zinc oxide is almost 77,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: As India's largest player in the industry with an installed capacity of almost 77,000 metric tons per annum, JGC is very well positioned to benefit from this consolidation trend going forward.

orders_capacity.claim: Zinc oxide capacity utilization exceeded 80% during Q2.
orders_capacity.quote: On the operational front, the company continued to deliver double-digit volume growth during Q2 with zinc oxide capacity utilization exceeding 80%.

orders_capacity.claim: JGC continued to deliver double-digit volume growth, with zinc oxide capacity utilisation exceeding 80% and further improvement expected.
orders_capacity.quote: JGC continued to deliver double-digit volume growth, with zinc oxide capacity utilisation exceeding 80% and further improvement expected.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity across manufacturing facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh is close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing is anchored at our facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh, which together today command an installed capacity of close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization stands in the early 80s.
orders_capacity.quote: So, the utilization levels are in early 80s right now as we speak.

capital_allocation.claim: The company had a net cash surplus of INR63.3 crores as of September 30, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We have a net cash surplus of INR63.3 crores as per 30th September 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: To further strengthen its international presence, JGC is incorporating BDJ Materials and Metals Trading FZCO, Dubai, as a step-down wholly owned subsidiary.
capital_allocation.quote: To further strengthen its international presence, JGC is incorporating BDJ Materials and Metals Trading FZCO, Dubai, as a step-down wholly owned subsidiary.

risks_headwinds.claim: Ongoing geopolitical conflicts have impacted global supply chains for zinc dross, the primary raw material.
risks_headwinds.quote: As we had mentioned earlier, the ongoing geopolitical conflict had impacted global supply chains for Zinc Dross, which is our primary raw material.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets reaching closer to a 14% to 15% EBITDA margin within 3 years.
management_commitments.quote: So I think on a blended basis, we are confident that in the next 3 years or so, we should be closer to the 14% to 15% EBITDA margin with the share of value-added products increasing.

management_commitments.claim: New capacities in Gujarat and Naidupeta are expected to be commissioned during FY27, positioning the Company to meet anticipated demand growth from the tyre sector and other end-user industries.
management_commitments.quote: New capacities in Gujarat and Naidupeta are expected to be commissioned during FY27, positioning the Company to meet anticipated demand growth from the tyre sector and other end-user industries.

management_commitments.claim: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield expansion remains on track for commissioning in Q4 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 1 of the zinc oxide production at Dahej is targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27 (estimated around November).
management_commitments.quote: Phase 1 of the zinc oxide production is targeted for commissioning, as I mentioned, in Q3 FY27.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
